evaluation.justice: Motor-only elevated passage, completely excluding pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
evaluation.safety: Full sound insulation barrier, isolation guardrail, wide straight lanes, high driving safety.
evaluation.livability: Pure transit facility, no livability function at all.
evaluation.sustainability: Hard infrastructure dominates, low ecological benefit.
evaluation.aesthetics: Neat elevated linear structure, modern urban transportation appearance.
evaluation.comfort: Wide flat road surface, sound insulation facilities reduce noise interference.
